email.subject: Cairns SCADA: who owns the water bid?
email.initial:
Hi Paul,

I’m reviewing Cairns Contract 3047, titled Citect to AVEVA Plant SCADA migration. If pump or sewer interfaces are included, there may be a useful split between SAGE’s migration engineering and Aquatec’s asset-specific acceptance tests.

The full scope and deadline are still unresolved, so this is only a scope check. No new pump supply or Aquatec work package is assumed.

Could you point me to your Queensland water or SCADA bid owner to assess whether this deserves a technical discussion? If there is a fit, I’d ask both sides before arranging an introduction with Jayden Seeley. Neither side has committed.

If this is outside your remit, a referral would help. If you would prefer no further emails, please let me know.
followups:

Following up on Cairns Contract 3047 SCADA migration. The first question is whether Aquatec would add a distinct, necessary work package. For your side, I had in mind: sCADA migration/integration lead candidate; obtain water/Queensland bid owner referral.

Hi Paul,

A practical agenda for the proposed Aquatec discussion would be: asset list; tag/alarm mapping; operating sequences; FAT/SAT; rollback; operator training. The output could be a one-page responsibility and evidence matrix before either firm spends time on a bid.

Which interface or qualification would you want to resolve first?

Hi Paul,

For Cairns Contract 3047 SCADA migration, I would keep the commercial discussion tied to an agreed work package, acceptance criteria and delivery capacity. There is no assumed award, fee split or partner commitment.

Would you be comfortable assessing a possible introduction with Jayden Seeley at Aquatec, once the access and scope questions are resolved?

Hi Paul,

I’ll close this proposed Aquatec introduction for now. If a technical discussion would be useful, let me know the right owner and I can coordinate once both sides agree. If this tender is not a fit, a brief “not this one” is enough.

If you prefer no further emails, please let me know.
